plan.summary: BRO-3139: londontheatre.co.uk prints no stars in the article body, but every review page carries the critic's rating in its embedded page data, so about 510 london-theatre reviews were scored by the LLM alone. The extractor now reads it; this refetches each review page once (plain GET, no scraping credits) and stores the stars as originalScore (n/5 -> n*20). Files with a human score are skipped.
steps: Run backfill-london-theatre-stars.js --apply in three chunks of 200.
